name: FORGE
identity: Original CMC evidence -> facts -> gap/conflict -> Module 3 candidate -> QC -> human review
case: Drug X 100 mg immediate-release tablet: independent synthetic exercise. SYN-A assay is 98.6% in its COA and 99.1% in the batch record; required evidence remains missing.
prep: Open /working-proof. This is the saved, read-only synthetic recruiter case. It is different from /demo, which is the separate session-only sandbox.
Prepare /working-proof?view=sources, /working-proof?view=working-proof and /recruiter as tabs. Prefer the saved case for the recording so the assessment stays reconstructable.
Check that CMC sources, Extraction, Gaps & conflicts, Module 3 drafts, Human review, CMC assessment and History & audit are present.
Existing fixture decisions are illustrative. Never present them as qualified professional review. An accepted submission is blocked while the conflict and required gaps remain.
routes: Work sample navigation confirmation -> Continue; or open the prepared saved-case URL
CMC assessment / CMC sources / Extraction / Gaps & conflicts / Module 3 drafts / Human review / History & audit
Session-only, editable synthetic case; not the saved recruiter record
VIEW CMC GAP ASSESSMENT -> confirmation -> Continue
Your account, saved workspace and existing roles; login off-camera

shots.title: Introduce the CMC task
shots.click: Show the landing identity, then open the prepared /working-proof tab. Do not confuse TRY SANDBOX with the saved recruiter case.
shots.proof: FORGE product identity and read-only saved synthetic work sample.
shots.cursor: Pause on the product name; then park beside Saved working proof.
shots.en: CMC documentation starts with dependable source facts. I am Rahul Dewangan, and FORGE is my independent work sample for organizing that evidence, identifying gaps and supporting controlled drafts.
shots.hi: FORGE ka purpose CMC documentation support hai. Landing se saved working proof kholo. Sandbox aur saved assessment ko same mat bolna. Yeh independent synthetic exercise hai, client project nahi.

shots.title: Inspect the original source records
shots.click: Click CMC sources. Inspect SYN-COA-A.json and SYN-BATCH-A.json; show source identity, original content and retained version.
shots.proof: The original synthetic records, labelled permission/scope and their source identities.
shots.cursor: Point once to the source names and original-value area; leave the record text unobstructed.
shots.en: Here are the original synthetic analytical records. Source identity, version and the original content remain attached, so a finding can be checked against the record that produced it.
shots.hi: Pehle source dikhao. Source name, original value aur version visible hona chahiye. Synthetic data ko real manufacturing batch result ya confidential company evidence nahi bolna.

shots.title: Make the numeric discrepancy understandable
shots.click: Click Extraction. Inspect the SYN-A assay facts and their exact source spans, raw values, unit and method context.
shots.proof: 98.6% versus 99.1% for the same synthetic batch; a 0.5 percentage-point difference.
shots.cursor: Move once between the two values. Give the numbers three seconds each; do not cover the percent sign.
shots.en: For the same synthetic batch, the COA records an assay of ninety-eight point six percent, while the batch record shows ninety-nine point one. The difference is half a percentage point.
shots.hi: Same batch mein do alag assay values hain: 98.6% aur 99.1%. Difference 0.5 percentage point hai. Dono values ke exact source references dikhane hain; correct value khud choose nahi karni.

shots.title: Show the conflict and missing evidence
shots.click: Click Gaps & conflicts. Show the open assay conflict and missing critical supporting information.
shots.proof: Unresolved same-batch conflict; missing dissolution and other required supporting evidence remain explicit.
shots.cursor: Point beside the conflict state and one important missing item. Leave HOLD visible in the frame.
shots.en: FORGE keeps that conflict unresolved. Required supporting evidence, including dissolution, is also missing. The system does not choose a convenient value or invent the absent result.
shots.hi: Ab gaps ka part important hai. Assay conflict unresolved rahega, aur missing dissolution missing hi rahega. Strong demo ka matlab fake complete output dikhana nahi, correct HOLD dikhana hai.

shots.title: Connect the gaps to Module 3
shots.click: Click CMC assessment. Show Available evidence and unresolved gaps, the Module 3 area, why it matters and next action. Expand an exact-source-reference row.
shots.proof: Source-backed observation -> Module 3 candidate location -> gap -> action -> review status.
shots.cursor: Move left to right across one table row, then stop next to its source-reference expansion.
shots.en: The saved gap assessment connects each observation to a relevant Module 3 area, explains why the gap matters and records the next evidence action. The mapping remains subject to professional review.
shots.hi: CMC assessment ki ek row dhang se explain karo: kya available hai, Module 3 mein kahan relevant hai, gap kyu matter karta hai aur next action kya hai. Mapping final applicability verdict nahi hai.

shots.title: Show draft and technical check together
shots.click: Click Module 3 drafts. Inspect the source-linked candidate and its recorded QC/missing-evidence state.
shots.proof: A draft candidate with evidence references and blockers; accepted Module 3 output remains blocked.
shots.cursor: Keep the draft state and a cited fact in the same crop. Do not crop away the missing-evidence warning.
shots.en: The Module 3 view shows a source-linked draft candidate with technical checks and visible blockers. Accepted output remains blocked while critical evidence is incomplete or conflicting.
shots.hi: Draft candidate dikhao, accepted submission nahi. Source links aur technical blockers ek saath visible hone chahiye. Evidence incomplete hai to good writing bhi approval replace nahi kar sakti.

shots.title: Explain illustrative decisions and real authority
shots.click: Click Human review. Read the illustrative request-evidence decision and current revision; do not attempt signing in the read-only case.
shots.proof: The exact recorded synthetic decision, its reason and the boundary requiring qualified review.
shots.cursor: Rest beside the request-evidence reason. Avoid hovering over approval controls for a misleading impression.
shots.en: The example review requests evidence. These fixture decisions are illustrative, not qualified professional approval. A real CMC, Regulatory or Quality reviewer remains responsible for the final judgement.
shots.hi: Yahan jo example decision hai woh synthetic fixture ka part hai. Use actual qualified reviewer approval nahi bolna. Real professional ko evidence aur exact revision dekhkar decision lena hai.

shots.title: Show readable output and recorded history
shots.click: Show History & audit and Verify audit chain: the saved-case dialog verifies the frozen work-sample hash, not a customer audit service. Close it. In the prepared recruiter tab open VIEW CMC GAP ASSESSMENT -> Continue.
shots.proof: Frozen saved-case integrity and a recruiter-facing gap report. No accepted submission or finalized export is claimed.
shots.cursor: One click for the saved integrity note, close, then one click to the prepared report. Keep the report limitation visible.
shots.en: The saved case preserves its evidence history. The gap report makes the findings and next steps readable, while retaining HOLD and the synthetic-exercise boundary.
shots.hi: History saved case ka hai. Verify button ka message dhyan se dikhao: yeh frozen sample integrity hai, full customer audit validation nahi. Gap report open karo, limitations ko hide mat karo.

shots.title: End with the work skill
shots.click: Return to CMC assessment with the controlled HOLD result visible.
shots.proof: CMC evidence organization, missing-data discipline and human-controlled drafting.
shots.en: FORGE demonstrates my approach to CMC documentation: traceable facts, explicit gaps, structured drafts and accountable human review.
shots.hi: Closing mein apni demonstrated skill bolo: CMC facts organize karna, gaps clear rakhna aur structured draft ko human review se connect karna. Commercial experience claim nahi karna.

optional: Separate editable demo: /demo?view=sources -> intake/extraction -> conflicts -> drafts -> QC -> reviews. Show the actual session result, and label the session-only persistence boundary.

Private delivery: use /app with permission-granted originals, separately authorized reviewer, exact current evidence and the existing export gates. Show the available PDF/Word/HTML/Technical ZIP buttons only for a real permitted snapshot.
Do not manufacture an export to remove HOLD. If Controlled exports is empty or blocked, explain the blocked result and use the recruiter-facing gap report instead.
